{"id":1989781344,"question_id":2571,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1777330886,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1989781344/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find the Pivot Integer","memory":"8.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int pivotInteger(int n) {\n        int total = (n * (n+1)) / 2;\n\n        int left = 0;\n        int right = total;\n\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<=n ; i++)\n        {\n            left += i;\n            if(left == right) return i;\n            right -= i;\n        }\n        return -1;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-the-pivot-integer","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1951}
